_readme2: Two sections: quick_run (daily, single param set) and param_sweep (monthly, all combos)
_quick_run_comment: Single fixed parameter set. Change these values to update your default daily run.
_param_sweep_comment: Arrays of values. Every combination is tested → 2000 rows output. MaxBuys(4) × BuyDrop(4) × Target(5) × Stoploss(5) × MaxDuration(5) = 2000 trade combos.

filter._comment: Filter ranges. All combinations of days_back × pct pairs × ath pairs tested. Invalid combos (min>=max) auto-skipped.

trade._comment: Trade param ranges. All combos tested per filter combo.
